Yin and Yang companions — Each one brings out the other animal's true colors like a prism, hence the term "Rainbow" — with this type of connection, you really get to see each other shine! It's a rare pairing, and should be cherished whenever you come across it! It takes a lot of self-work before most people are ready for this type of connection — after all, the full spectrum of your true colors will be on display the entire time, so you'd better be sure you have all your facets polished and shiny!

page.connType.shadow.p.this-darkly-magne: This darkly magnetic Yin-Yang animal pairing shows each other's hidden underbellies — revealing what might otherwise stay hidden, whether you like it or not! It's a fantastic pairing for karmic work, helping you both to grow through staying committed to the bond and discovering what to work on together. I've seen it in plenty of romantic couples, even husbands and wives who've been happily married for years, but I've also seen it most easily displayed in student-teacher or parent-child pairings, where the idea of working out your faults and improving yourself is already baked into the type of relationship.

page.connType.mirror-opposite.p.opposite: Opposites on the zodiac wheel — six signs apart, facing each other directly across the circle. Ideal for reflecting blindspots and learning from a radically different point of view.

Opposites on the zodiac wheel — six signs apart, facing each other directly across the circle. These connections are perfect for reflecting ourselves and seeing each other's blindspots — as they are quite literally facing the opposite direction that you are! This can make for some heated arguments, but as long as you bring enough respect to the table, there's a lot to learn here from your mirrors — both of you can see things that the other cannot, so as long as you trust each other and act in good faith, this can be a very helpful and beautiful connection to have. It will most definitely keep things interesting, as they will no doubt have a different take on things than you, sometimes so radically different that you didn't even think it was possible!

page.connType.values-trine.p.shared-valu: Shared value — both animals belong to the same Values Triangle, so you often speak the same language when it comes to life's priorities.

Shared value — both animals belong to the same Values Triangle: Power & Prestige, Security & Stability, Inspiration & Idealism, or Peace & Harmony. These connections are people who speak the same language as you, values-wise. They have similar priorities when it comes to how to go about dealing with life — whether that be the pursuit of power and craftsmanship in a trade, or the pursuit of peace and an easy-going lifestyle. These are people you don't have to explain yourself to very often, because they're already on the same page as you, so it can be great for any type of relationship: business or pleasure, family or friendship. Cool runnings :)

page.connType.same-as-me.p.the-same-tote: The same totem animal at the same pillar — or the same animal in a different "ring" born 12, 24, or 36 years apart. Same guides; wonderfully different people.

The same totem animal at the same level — someone who shares your Spirit, Mind, Heart, or Body guide exactly. It can also be people from different 'rings' so to speak — in other words people born 12, 24, 36, or some other multiple of 12 years apart from you. For example, I am a Fire Tiger born in 1986, but I have some wonderful Tiger family and friends who are born in different Tiger rings — one of my uncles is a Water Tiger born in 1962, my son is a Metal Tiger born in 2010, and several dear friends, students, and companions are Earth Tigers born in 1998. I've also had coworkers who were born in the year of the Wood Tiger, 1974. It can be cool to see how your animals act when they've got different elemental flavors charging their energy in other people. It can also be neat to find people born on the same exact birthdate as you, so they've got all the same animal guides, or at least 3 out of 4 if the hour animal is different, and to see how they've chosen to play their hand differently than the way you've chosen to play yours — kind of like how 'identical' twins are different in many respects, but share lots of things in other areas. Free will is a powerful thing, and this connection shows that most clearly. The birth animals guiding them are the same, but the people being guided still turn out completely and wonderfully different :)
